name: WASP_3MT_HDP_XL_common
machine_start_gcode:
; WASP 3MT HDP XL: Firecap chamber, nozzle T0, barrel/preheat T1
M106 S0 P0 ; fan off
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Firecap heated chamber
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; nozzle
M104 S240 T1 ; barrel/preheat zone (validate per material)
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; wait for nozzle
M109 S240 T1 ; wait for barrel/preheat zone
G28 ; home delta
G90 ; absolute XYZ positioning
M82 ; absolute extrusion distances
G92 E0
T0 ; select nozzle tool
; Purge vertically at the outer edge of the bed
G1 E-20 F3000
G1 X490 Y0 Z5 F9000
G1 Z1 F3000
G1 Z7 E700 F2000
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
M107 ; fan off
M104 S0 T0 ; nozzle off
M104 S0 T1 ; barrel/preheat zone off
M140 S0 ; Firecap chamber off
G28 ; home axes
